lines.en: I walk on two legs with a long stride

lines.zh: 我的加特林臂在身侧晃
lines.en: My Gatling arm swings at my side
My ears stay pricked
I circle near my anchor
Every step lands solid

lines.zh: 我的加特林臂在身侧晃，朝主人走。
lines.en: My gatling arm sways as I head for my master.
My goggles catch the light
I patrol the forest edge
I stop and sniff

lines.zh: 我的尾巴很短，摆得很快
lines.en: My short tail wags fast
I go side-on through the brush

lines.zh: 加特林手臂，转起来不停。
lines.en: This gatling arm does not stop spinning.
I sit with my ears still turning

lines.zh: 我把加特林臂检查了一遍
lines.en: I check my Gatling arm
I part my lips and show a little tooth
I listen to the wood

lines.zh: 我的加特林臂，转起来了。
lines.en: My gatling arm starts spinning.
I wait for your order
Sun warms the back of my hand
I grind my back teeth
I lie down by the anchor

lines.zh: 我的护目镜上有一点雾
lines.en: A little fog on my goggles
There's nothing here but grass
I listen once more

lines.zh: 我张大嘴打了一个哈欠
lines.en: I yawn wide once
I rest my forepaws together
I lift my head and look right at you

lines.zh: 你身上的气味我很熟悉
lines.en: I know the smell of you well

lines.zh: 你的手别伸到我的枪口前
lines.en: Keep your hand off my muzzle
I wait for your word
I've sat down
Do you want me with you

lines.zh: 我这只加特林臂，还没热。
lines.en: My gatling arm isn't warm yet.
There's some dust on your shoulder
I close my eyes notch by notch
I'm getting up
I'm taller than you
I'm on your left
Walk on and I'll follow
I wait for you to pat me
I can put my arm down
I trust you as a person

lines.zh: 我护住 Gatling Arm，那是我的命。
lines.en: I shield my Gatling Arm; it is my life.

lines.zh: 我从喉咙里滚出一声低吼
lines.en: A growl rolls out of my throat
My ears flatten to my head

lines.zh: 我的护目镜歪了，加特林手臂还在转。
lines.en: My goggles slipped; the Gatling arm still spins.
I re-aim the muzzle

lines.zh: 弹壳卡了一下，我抖掉它。
lines.en: A shell casing jams; I shake it loose.
That one landed hard
I've held my ground
I'm still at your left
I can still go on

lines.zh: 你手里的东西我闻到了
lines.en: I smell what you're holding
Can I eat this
I open my mouth and only steam comes out
I won't snatch; I'll wait
Lower it a bit for me
I eat it clean

lines.zh: 你身上还有别的东西吗
lines.en: Have you got anything else on you

lines.zh: 矿石的甜味，我闻得出来。
lines.en: I can smell the sweetness of ore.
This one agrees with me
I will not snatch; I wait.
Don't let your hand wobble

lines.zh: 你手里的肉干，我盯着不动。
lines.en: My eyes fix on the jerky in your hand.

lines.zh: 你撞在我身上，我稳住了
lines.en: You hit me and I hold

lines.zh: 我的加特林臂挡了一下
lines.en: My Gatling arm takes some of it

lines.zh: 你从我的枪臂下面钻过
lines.en: You duck under my gun arm

lines.zh: 我们两个一起撞上了树
lines.en: We both ran into a tree
My shoulder moves you aside

lines.zh: 我把枪臂往后收了半步
lines.en: I draw my gun arm back half a step
My ears flatten once
You stepped on my paw
I give up half a body's width
That barely counted
There's another by the anchor
We lean in and sniff each other
Its goggles are older than mine
We lie down together
Its ear tilts toward me
We sit back to back
We listen to the wood together
Neither of us moves first

lines.zh: 主人来了，我们一起站起来
lines.en: The tamer comes and we both rise
We walk along together
I pick it up with a claw
I bite it; it's hard
I hand it to my tamer
It's smaller than my palm
I tuck it into the pouch at my hip
Could this be ammunition
It rolls to my foot
I pick it up and set it aside
This is no good to me
I'll leave it for you
Something's near the anchor

lines.zh: 我的加特林臂抬起来了
lines.en: My Gatling arm is up
I plant myself in front of you
That's not one of us
I let out a breath
Both my ears point forward
I bark once at it first
It doesn't give a step
Then let's fight
I drop my gun arm to the hip line

lines.zh: 我在矿洞入口，蹲下替你望风。
lines.en: At the mine mouth, I crouch and keep watch.
I am pouncing now, do not dodge.
I circle it round and round
My muzzle stays on it
It goes left and I cut across
The Gatling Arm is spinning up.

lines.zh: 加特林臂开始转，我先瞄准。
lines.en: My Gatling Arm spins up; I aim first.
It wants your back; I block it
I close in inch by inch
My claws bite into the soil
I'm ready to fire
This one has to land

lines.zh: 它退一步，我的炮口跟一步。
lines.en: It backs up one step; my barrel follows.
I hold right here
My Gatling arm opens up
The burst hits its shoulder
My claws sweep in
The blow knocks it back
I ram it with my shoulder
That one went wide
Its hide is harder than I thought
I add another burst
It seizes my gun arm
I shake it off
My teeth catch its leg
I pull back and raise the arm
I come out of the trees over the leaf litter

lines.zh: 我的加特林臂先露出来
lines.en: My Gatling arm shows first
I stop beside the anchor
My ears turn first
I sniff this ground

lines.zh: 阳光照在我的护目镜上
lines.en: Sun hits my goggles

lines.zh: 我站直了，比你高出半个头
lines.en: I straighten, half a head over you
This is a good place to camp

lines.zh: 我从数据流里站起，甲片合拢。
lines.en: I stand out of the data stream, plates closing.
I'll wait here for you to speak

lines.zh: 我听见有人在叫我的名字
lines.en: I hear someone call my name
I come to a stop in the shade

lines.zh: 火燎到我的手臂，我甩了两下
lines.en: Fire catches my arm and I shake it twice

lines.zh: 我从坡上摔下去，滚了两圈
lines.en: I fall off a slope and roll twice
Water in my barrel; I must shake it dry.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我的护目镜震歪了
lines.en: The blast knocks my goggles crooked
A round hits my shoulder plate

lines.zh: 那股力量把我的手指冻住了
lines.en: That force freezes my fingers shut
I haven't fed in a long while

lines.zh: 雷打在我身上，我跪了一下
lines.en: Lightning hits me and I drop to one knee
No ground below; my claws find nothing
